events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, team and calendar
events.decision: Confirm the engagement scope, team and calendar?
agenda: Present the objectives, phases and deliverables of the engagement
Align on client and project team roles
Confirm the steering calendar and next steps

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Accept the causes found for the 2025 prepaid churn rise as the basis for design?
agenda: Present the prepaid churn baseline by customer group and tenure
Review the retention offer and store handling findings
Discuss the causes of the 2025 prepaid churn rise

events.label: Program approval
events.purpose: Review the program design and rollout plan
events.decision: Approve the retention program and its rollout plan?
agenda: Present target customer groups, churn measures and tracking rules
Review the retention offer set and the store actions
Discuss the rollout plan ahead of program approval

events.label: Check-in: early rollout
events.decision: Confirm the early results and the next steps to put to the final readout?
agenda: Present live offers, store actions and the churn tracker
Review early churn movement against the diagnostic baseline
Discuss the next steps to put to the final readout

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review rollout results and next steps
events.decision: Accept the rollout results and the next steps for the retention program?
agenda: Present the rollout results against the diagnostic baseline
Review live offers, store actions and the churn tracker
Decide whether to accept the results and next steps
